messages:
maria (docs): Heads-up — infra changed the offline installer layout in last deploy. Packaging now puts runtime deps under /vendor/runtime instead of /opt/redwood/lib. This breaks several examples in private/vpc/onprem install guide.
aj (eng): thanks for flagging. which examples are affected? the KMS/HSM quickstart or the systemd bits?
sam (infra): both. KMS client artifacts moved into a separate `redwood-kms-client` tarball, and PKCS#11 socket path was normalized to /run/redwood/pkcs11.sock.
maria (docs): ok — action items: update install steps (tarball names + extraction paths), update the HSM snippet that references the old socket, and add a short migration note for existing customers.
kevin (security): also note that we added a checksum file at /vendor/SHA256SUMS to the offline bundle. docs should recommend verifying it and show the gpg verify step.
aj (eng): Sam, can you paste the quick command to extract the new bundle? want to plug into docs.
sam (infra): sure — use this:
```
# unpack runtime and kms client
tar -xzf redwood-offline-runtime-2026.03.18.tgz -C /opt/redwood
tar -xzf redwood-kms-client-2026.03.18.tgz -C /opt/redwood/vendor
```
Also the installer will accept --vendor-dir=/opt/redwood/vendor now.
maria (docs): perfect, will add snippet. I'll also include the PKCS#11 path change. Current HSM example in docs uses /var/run/pkcs11; replace with /run/redwood/pkcs11.sock.
aj (eng): For migration guide, add a note: if you previously had PKCS11 path at /var/run/pkcs11, create a symlink during upgrade: `ln -s /run/redwood/pkcs11.sock /var/run/pkcs11` — but mark this as temporary workaround.
kevin (security): prefer we recommend updating the HSM config rather than symlinking. But include the symlink as a rollback/temporary step. Also add ACL guidance: systemd unit now runs as `redwood` user, ensure group `hsm` has read access.
maria (docs): adding exact systemd unit override example now.
```
[Service]
RuntimeDirectory=redwood
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
ExecStartPost=/bin/chown redwood:hsm /run/redwood/pkcs11.sock
```

maria (docs): small PR plan: 1) update quickstart snippets, 2) add migration note, 3) add checksum+gpg verify example, 4) link to new tarball names. I can draft a PR tonight.
aj (eng): can you also add a one-liner for SDK users? many embed the old path in example code. maybe a snippet for the python sdk config: `kms.socket_path = "/run/redwood/pkcs11.sock"`
maria (docs): yep. will add python and go examples.
ci-bot: build/test note — docs lint OK but example-snippet-check failed on `private/install.md` because path `/opt/redwood/lib` is not found in repo.
sam (infra): thanks ci-bot — that'll be fixed by the PR. I can also push a small helper script to installer repo that prints current layout: `/usr/local/bin/redwood-inspect-bundle`
maria (docs): nice. will reference that script.
aj (eng): timeline: if docs PR lands before EOD tomorrow, we can include it in the release notes for the offline bundle change. Otherwise, do a post-release errata.
kevin (security): don't forget to mention checksum verification and GPG key fingerprint in the docs frontmatter. I'll drop the key fingerprint here: `3F2A 9B8C 4D12 7E90 12AB  4CDE 98F1 334B 5E6A 7C2D`.
maria (docs): got it. I'll include the fingerprint and a short howto: `curl https://downloads.redwood.ai/keys/pubring.gpg | gpg --import` then `gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.sig SHA256SUMS`.
aj (eng): looks good. maria, ping me on the PR when draft is ready and I'll do a quick technical review.
maria (docs): will do — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
